faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Welcome to The Handle Factory's Frequently Asked Questions page. Here you'll find helpful information about our products, ordering process, payment options, shipping, returns, refunds, and customer support.

items.question: What is The Handle Factory?
items.answer: The Handle Factory is a UK-based online store offering a selection of home heating solutions, power equipment, and related accessories. Our product categories include: Wood Stove Accessories Fireplaces Generators Water Heaters Saunas Furnaces & Boilers Our goal is to provide customers with a straightforward and reliable online shopping experience.

items.question: Where is The Handle Factory located?
items.answer: Our business details are: Legal Business Name: THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD Address: Studio 210, 134–136 Curtain Road, London, England EC2A 3AR, United Kingdom Website: https://thehandlefactory.uk Email: info@thehandlefactory.uk Phone: +44 20 1219 1343

items.question: Do you have a physical showroom?
items.answer: Our website operates as an online store. Please contact our customer support team before planning any visit to our business address.

items.question: Are your products brand new?
items.answer: We sell products advertised as new. Product specifications, condition, and any included accessories are described on the relevant product pages. If you have questions about a particular item, please contact us before placing your order.

items.question: Are your products genuine?
items.answer: Products are supplied as the brands and models described in their listings. If you require confirmation of a particular manufacturer's warranty or product specification, please contact our support team before purchasing.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Ordering from The Handle Factory is straightforward: 1. Browse our website and select your preferred product. 2. Review the product specifications and availability. 3. Add the product to your basket. 4. Proceed to checkout. 5. Enter your delivery and billing information. 6. Select an available payment method and complete your purchase. After successfully placing your order, you should receive an order confirmation at the email address provided during checkout.

items.question: What currency do you accept?
items.answer: All prices on our website are displayed in British Pounds Sterling (GBP, £).

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: The payment methods currently available to you will be displayed during checkout. Please review the available options before completing your purchase. For more information, visit our Payment Methods page.

items.question: Can I change my order after placing it?
items.answer: If you need to change your order, please contact us as soon as possible at info@thehandlefactory.uk. We will review your request. Changes may not be possible once an order has entered the dispatch process.

items.question: Can I cancel my order?
items.answer: You can contact us to request cancellation before dispatch. If your order has already been dispatched, you may still have cancellation and return rights under applicable UK consumer law. For complete details, please refer to our Order Cancellation Policy.

items.question: How can I check my order status?
items.answer: You can check available order information through our Track Your Order page or contact our customer support team. When contacting us, please provide your order number and the email address used during checkout.

items.question: Do you offer free shipping?
items.answer: Yes. We offer free standard shipping on all orders delivered within the United Kingdom. There is no minimum order value required to qualify for free standard shipping.

items.question: Where do you deliver?
items.answer: We currently offer delivery to eligible addresses throughout the United Kingdom. If you are unsure whether your postcode is eligible for delivery, please contact us before placing your order.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Our estimated standard delivery timeframe is 5–7 business days. This consists of: Order handling: 3 business days Shipping transit: 2–4 business days Estimated total delivery: 5–7 business days Business days are Monday to Friday, excluding applicable public holidays. These are estimates rather than guaranteed delivery dates.

items.question: What is your order cut-off time?
items.answer: Our order cut-off time is 12:00 AM (midnight), GMT, as configured in our shipping schedule. Orders are processed on business days, Monday to Friday.

items.question: How much does shipping cost?
items.answer: Standard shipping is completely free for eligible UK orders, regardless of the order value.

items.question: Will I receive tracking information?
items.answer: When tracking is available for your shipment, the relevant tracking information will be provided so you can monitor delivery progress. If you need assistance locating your tracking details, contact info@thehandlefactory.uk.

items.question: What happens if my order is delayed?
items.answer: Although we aim to deliver within the estimated timeframe, unexpected carrier delays or other circumstances may affect delivery. If your order has not arrived within the expected period, please contact our support team with your order number. Your statutory delivery rights remain unaffected.

items.question: Can I collect my order in person?
items.answer: Please contact customer support to confirm whether collection is available for your particular order. Do not visit our business address for collection without prior confirmation.

items.question: What is your return policy?
items.answer: We accept eligible returns within 30 days. Our returns policy covers both defective and non-defective products, subject to the applicable return conditions and your statutory consumer rights.

items.question: What condition must returned products be in?
items.answer: For standard non-defective returns, products should be in new condition, with their original accessories and packaging where reasonably possible. Different rules may apply to defective or non-conforming goods under UK consumer law. Your statutory rights are not restricted by our standard return conditions.

items.question: Do you accept exchanges?
items.answer: Yes. We accept exchanges. If you wish to exchange a product, contact our customer support team with your order number and the details of your request. Exchange arrangements may depend on product availability.

items.question: How do I return a product?
items.answer: To initiate a return: 1. Contact info@thehandlefactory.uk with your order number. 2. Explain the reason for your return. 3. Our team will provide return instructions. 4. Use the prepaid return label included in your package. 5. Send the product back according to the provided instructions. Please retain proof of postage until your return has been resolved.

items.question: Do I have to pay return shipping fees?
items.answer: No. We provide a free prepaid return label included in the package. There are no standard return shipping charges for eligible returns made using the provided label.

items.question: Do you charge restocking fees?
items.answer: No. We do not charge restocking fees.

items.question: How long does a refund take?
items.answer: Our stated refund processing timeframe is within 10 days. Refund timing depends on the circumstances of the return, and we will comply with applicable UK consumer refund deadlines. Once a refund has been issued, the time required for the funds to appear in your account may depend on your payment provider.

items.question: Can I return a defective or damaged product?
items.answer: Yes. If your product arrives damaged, defective, or not as described, please contact us with your order number and details of the issue. Photographs may help us investigate the problem, but they do not replace your statutory rights. We will review the issue and provide an appropriate remedy in accordance with UK consumer law.

items.question: Can I return a product if I change my mind?
items.answer: Yes. We accept eligible non-defective returns within our 30-day return window. Please contact our team for instructions and review the full Returns & Refunds Policy for the applicable conditions.

items.question: Do your products come with a warranty?
items.answer: Warranty coverage varies depending on the product and manufacturer. Where a manufacturer's or commercial warranty is available, the relevant details should be provided in the product information or accompanying documentation. Your statutory consumer rights apply independently of any commercial warranty.

items.question: Can you help me choose the right product?
items.answer: Yes. Our customer support team can assist with general product information, specifications, and compatibility enquiries. For installations involving gas, electrical systems, combustion appliances, or other safety-critical equipment, consult an appropriately qualified professional.

items.question: Do fireplaces and boilers require professional installation?
items.answer: Certain fireplaces, boilers, water heaters, and heating systems require professional installation to comply with safety regulations and manufacturer instructions. Depending on the appliance, this may require a Gas Safe registered engineer, a suitably qualified electrician, or another competent installer. Always check the specific product's installation requirements before purchasing.

items.question: Are generators suitable for indoor use?
items.answer: No. Petrol, diesel, and other fuel-burning generators must never be operated indoors or in enclosed spaces. They can produce deadly carbon monoxide. Always follow the manufacturer's safety instructions and use the equipment only in suitable outdoor locations.

items.question: Can I purchase replacement parts or accessories?
items.answer: You can browse our Wood Stove Accessories category and other relevant product listings. If you need a specific replacement component, contact us with the product brand, model number, and part details.

items.question: How can I contact The Handle Factory?
items.answer: You can reach us through the following channels: Email: info@thehandlefactory.uk Phone: +44 20 1219 1343 Website: https://thehandlefactory.uk Business Address: THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD Studio 210, 134–136 Curtain Road London, England EC2A 3AR United Kingdom

items.question: What information should I provide when contacting support?
items.answer: For order-related enquiries, please include: Your full name Your order number The email address used at checkout A brief description of your enquiry For product issues, you may also provide the product model and relevant photographs. Please do not send passwords or full payment card details.

items.question: What should I do if I receive the wrong product?
items.answer: If you receive an incorrect item, please contact us promptly at info@thehandlefactory.uk. Provide your order number and a description of the item received. We will review the issue and arrange an appropriate resolution.

items.question: How can I make a complaint?
items.answer: If you are dissatisfied with any aspect of your shopping experience, please email info@thehandlefactory.uk with the subject line Customer Complaint. Include your order number, a description of the issue, and your preferred resolution. Our team will review your complaint and respond as soon as reasonably possible.

items.question: Is my personal information protected?
items.answer: We take customer privacy seriously and aim to handle personal information in accordance with applicable UK data protection requirements. Please review our Privacy Policy for details about how personal information is collected, used, stored, and shared.

items.question: Will you share my information with third parties?
items.answer: We may share information with service providers where necessary to process payments, fulfil orders, deliver purchases, provide customer support, or meet legal obligations. Further details are available in our Privacy Policy.

items.question: How can I request information about my personal data?
items.answer: You can contact info@thehandlefactory.uk to make a privacy-related enquiry or exercise applicable data protection rights.

items.question: Still Need Help?
items.answer: If your question hasn't been answered above, our customer support team is here to assist.
